body:
Suggested title: P104 lower-bound guidance: exact open targets, k = 72/73 full-LP certificates, witnesses and lane notes (follow-up to #7852)

## Summary
Follow-up to #7852 (the lower-bound toolkit). No kappa claim. This package states the open cores of the P104 lower-bound programme precisely and ships the exact data behind them.

- `OPEN-PROBLEMS.md`: (a) NET-D56 in drop form (DX cut, zero-drop contraction, JUNK-PAYS-inv), (b) R side (chain law, rank-8 sector, ChainWall56@Q96 / 2-adic tensor bound), (c) caller mid-k window (HP(k), LEAF-CHANNEL, eigenspace laws, TURAN/SPARSE/TRIPLE/RELAY-HALL, Q >= 1 HQ2, tightness, DECOMP), (d) loose decoder rows, (e) general decoder wall; plus the CERTKIT (#7829) source-identity item (#7864).
- `certs/` [C]: exact weak-duality certificates with stdlib verifiers (pricing DP included). The Q = 0 full LP gives 128.8500719 at k = 72 and 128.6813251 at k = 73 (below 128.891) and 129.0372595 at k = 71 (above); the stored exact rational duals answer the missing-certificate point raised in #7856. These are conditional LP bounds: RC2 is [P] (Lean), the other rows are paper-[P]. The Q >= 1 thin-column LP certificates cover k = 13, 76..100, 110, 120.
- `data/` [C]: 15 legal tight Q = 0 caller words (k = 3..13) replayed exactly at four q; direct-sum tightness witnesses (HP(327) < chat(C1)); TIGHT55 symmetry-gap witnesses.
- `notes/` (101 lane notes + index), `code/` (our own lane scripts and small logs), `lean_extra/` (11 same-day Lean sources not in #7852, sources only, not rebuilt here).
- `CORRECTIONS.md`: TIGHT55 first scheme not a proof (repair certified in #7852), level wall false, CT-COVER false, DECOMP false, S_spec 865.58 not a valid floor.

## Validation
`python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-lowerbound-guidance` gives PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE; `verify.py` (stdlib, about 30 s) pins every file, token-scans lean_extra, scrubs paths, runs both certificate verifiers and the witness checks. Lean is not run in this package.

## Open next questions
Network-coding gain on Q96 (NET-D56 drop form, ChainWall56@Q96); the caller mid-k window and a tightness-free Q = 0 law; loose B-linear rows; the general decoder wall; the CERTKIT source-identity theorem.

DreamingOfClouds with Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), via Claude Code
